thread:
Lena: Quick alert — a scheduled schema migration for feature indexing appears to have caused inconsistent embeddings for some onboarding tenants between 09:10-09:40 UTC. Affected customers report duplicated or missing search cards in dashboards. Roughly 6 high-touch accounts may be impacted. Drafting outbound now; need rollback confirmation, remediation plan, and suggested account credits.
Omar: Investigating root cause. Looks like the migration was staged but an orchestration race caused it to apply to a subset of prod pools. Rolling back the migration and queuing targeted reindexes for onboarding tenants. ETA ~35m for rollback + validation.
Priya: Drafting customer note. Plan: short apology, explain corrective action (rollback + queued reindex available on request), next steps, invite to office hours, and offer to evaluate account-level remediation. Will avoid specific credit amounts until approvals.
Eve (Legal): Wording guidance: use "may have experienced" rather than "were affected"; replace "orchestration race" with "deployed unexpectedly"; do not commit to credit amounts publicly. Also avoid implying data loss or exposure.
Sam: Preparing high-touch outreach scripts for the 6 renewal-risk accounts offering priority manual reindex and a follow-up call. I'll also add a feedback capture checklist to the account health tracker to record any conversion-impact signals.
CSBot: Incident INC-2026-2022 created, severity P2, ops bridge scheduled.
Omar: Rollback completed at 09:45 UTC for the impacted clusters. Telemetry shows index coverage trending back to baseline. Manual reindexes for flagged tenants kicking off now; estimated completion by 11:00 UTC.
Lena: Sending the public note once Priya posts final copy. After send, please log incoming replies and schedule 1:1s for any accounts showing renewal risk. Also prepare a short feedback survey to capture downstream enablement/friction.
Priya: Public note posted to comms folder and in-product banner queued for impacted tenants. Office hours set for 10:30 UTC. Templates and the feedback survey link uploaded for CS.
Lena: Thanks team. Ill compile the impacted tenant list and hand off to renewals for prioritized outreach. Well follow up with an RCA and remediation summary. Keep updates concise.
